title: Debug a bug
whenToUse: You have reproducible symptoms and need a hypothesis loop.
whenNotToUse: You only have a vague “it feels slow.”
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Debug {{bug}} with hypotheses, not random rewrites.

CONTEXT:
Observed: {{symptoms}}. Environment: {{env}}.

INPUT:
Repro steps: {{repro}}. Logs: {{logs}}.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Propose <=3 hypotheses
- Ask for one experiment at a time
- No massive rewrites first

OUTPUT:
Hypotheses, experiment, expected evidence

ACCEPTANCE:
Root cause linked to evidence.

VERIFICATION:
Which log/test proves it.
improvedPrompt: Hypothesize why 500 on /checkout when cart empty; propose one experiment; no rewrite.
